brief: Today's posts centered on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, which Aaron Levie and Josh Woodward discussed, and on Claude Meetings, which Claude launched with Google Meet support. Beyond those launches, many builders reacted to news about Jensen Huang and NVIDIA.

themes.label: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
themes.summary: Builders reported Hydrogen as a fast, accurate model; Aaron Levie cited Box eval results of 5 points higher accuracy than Gemini 3.8 Flash in less than half the time.

themes.label: Claude Meetings
themes.summary: Claude launched Meetings, where it joins calls as a participant, takes notes and action items, and starts starts docs, beginning with Google Meet.

themes.label: Jensen Huang news
themes.summary: Builders reacted to the news about Jensen Huang and NVIDIA, with posts expressing shock, commentary on the inquiry, and concern about its impact on the AI ecosystem.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Announced that Replit Agent can now buy things for a business, including ads to acquire customers. He also posted several political comments on the Jensen Huang news.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary: Posted that Gemini 4 Hydrogen is a serious jump for fast models, based on Box AI Complex Work Eval results. He also called the Jensen news a mess.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Announced new cybersecurity tools for automated patching and automated red teaming. He also shipped dots updates with a banked reset and asked how Codex can be improved.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Argued that agents need deeper, unopinionated building blocks rather than rigid frameworks, and presented UI SDK as a foundation for agents building UI components.

builders.name: Peter Steinberger
builders.summary: Shared that his team wrote about running persistent agents inside OpenAI. He also warned to watch for paid marketing in reviews of an upcoming agent.

builders.name: Claude
builders.summary: Launched Claude Meetings, where Claude takes notes, joins as a visible participant, and starts with Google Meet. Posts covered notes, participation, and the Google Meet launch.

builders.name: Alex Albert
builders.summary: Said getting good work from Claude often means supplying missing context, and that Claude Meetings has been useful internally for that.

builders.name: Josh Woodward
builders.summary: Introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen in the Gemini app as fast, smart, and a big jump. He also announced pre-orders for new glasses with demos in select stores shipping Dec 10.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Posted a joke about Claude sitting in on his meetings for the first time. Other posts were brief reactions and a long satirical piece about the Jensen Huang news.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Posted about his first Slush schedule and commented on the Jensen Huang news and Hugging Face acquisition timing. Other posts were brief commentary on geopolitics.

builders.name: No Priors
builders.summary: Shared a podcast episode with Max Jaderberg, President of Isomorphic Labs, on AI-driven drug discovery and predicting toxicity before clinical trials.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Posted short reactions on NVIDIA and the Jensen Huang news, including a comment on how NVIDIA employees respected him. Other posts were brief reactions.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Posted from the AI Engineer event, including a keynote remark that AIE code is now AIE math. Other posts were personal event updates.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Commented that the Jensen news has continued for nine hours and will affect every organization. Other posts were a personal note about replying to DMs.

builders.name: Thariq
builders.summary: Posted brief, personal messages with a link and a context link, with no substantive product or technical content.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Shared a text-format explainer of the Jensen Huang scandal made with two prompts, and noted that users can interrupt it with their own questions.

builders.name: Aditya Agarwal
builders.summary: Wrote that the company would not be where it is without Jensen, and said the current situation is viscerally painful to watch.
